# BayLumPlus ![](reference/figures/logo_BayLum.png)

An R package for chronological **Bay**esian models integrated for
Optically Stimulated (OSL) **Lum**inescence Dating

**BayLumPlus** is a a refined fork of the original
[`BayLum`](https://crp2a.github.io/BayLum/) R package. This update
introduces several new capabilities, particularly for the Age
processing, where we aim to test different prior assumptions without
incurring the computational cost associated with the Palaeodose Model.

``` R
To cite the R package 'BayLumPlus' please cite the R package itself and the following article:

  Bouafia I, Christophe C, Philippe A, Kreutzer S, Guérin G, Baumgarten F, Frerebeau N (2024). _BayLumPlus: Chronological
  Bayesian Models Integrating Optically Stimulated Luminescence and Radiocarbon Age Dating_. R package version 1.0.0,
  <https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/>.

  Philippe A, Guerin G, Kreutzer S (2019). "BayLum - An R package for Bayesian analysis of OSL ages: An introduction."
  _Quaternary Geochronology_, *49*, 16-24. doi:10.1016/j.quageo.2018.05.009 <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.quageo.2018.05.009>.
```

## Installation

**You need to have [JAGS](https://mcmc-jags.sourceforge.io) installed on
your computer.**

The package **BayLumPlus** has only a development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("imn167/BayLumPLus")
```

Please note that development versions may change day by day.

## About this Extension

### Graph Theory for Stratigraphic Constraints

To support the modeling of stratigraphic relationships, we introduce
graph-based functions:

- [`network_vizualization()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/network_vizualization.md)
  – visualizes stratigraphic constraints as a graph  
- [`remove_transitive_edges()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/remove_transitive_edges.md)
  – called Edge Pruner Algorithm (EPA), it removes redundant edges
  implied by transitivity

These tools help simplify and explore complex stratigraphic
relationships more intuitively.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Bayesian Age Modeling with `Compute_AgeS_D()`

We introduce a new modeling function:
[`Compute_AgeS_D()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Compute_AgeS_D.md),
focused on Bayesian age estimation under various prior structures.

**Supported priors include:**

- Bayesian prior for OSL datasets:

  - `constrained_Jeffrey`: Uniform order on the log-scale (chain-like
    constraints)  
  - `StrictNicholls&Jones`: Based on the Uniform Order prior, from the
    original `BayLum`  
  - `unconstrained_Jeffrey`: For unstructured or weakly constrained
    stratigraphy

- Bayesian prior for the simple approach where the likelihood is
  $M_{i} \sim \mathcal{N}\left( A_{i},\sigma_{i}^{2} \right)\quad\forall i$:

  - `unconstrained`
  - `uniform_order`
  - `Nicholls&Jones`

*All priors for age processing are stored in the data `ModelAgePrior` to
get an easy access please use `extract_Jags_Model()`interactive
function.*

### Isotonic Distortion Framework

`BayLumPlus` introduces a new Bayesian modeling strategy called
**Isotonic Distortion**, implemented via:

- [`IsotonicCurve()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/IsotonicCurve.md)
  – fits the isotonic model  
- [`PlotIsotonicCurve()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/PlotIsotonicCurve.md)
  – visualizes the results with ggplots

This framework supports partial order constraints in ages, offering a
flexible and interpretable alternative to traditional priors.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Comparing Priors with `plotHpd()`

To facilitate the comparison of different modeling choices and prior
structures, the
[`plotHpd()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/plotHpd.md)
function allows visual comparison of **Highest Posterior Density (HPD)**
intervals under different model settings.

This is particularly useful for:

- Sensitivity analysis  
- Model comparison  
- Reporting credible intervals with varying assumptions

# Package index

## All functions

- [`AgeC14_Computation()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/AgeC14_Computation.md)
  : Bayesian analysis for C-14 age estimations of various samples

- [`AgeS`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/AgeS.md) :

  Output of `AgeS_Computation` function for the samples: "GDB5" and
  "GDB3"

- [`AgeS_Computation()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/AgeS_Computation.md)
  : Bayesian analysis for OSL age estimation of various samples

- [`Age_Computation()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Age_Computation.md)
  : Bayesian analysis for the OSL age estimation of one sample

- [`Age_OSLC14()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Age_OSLC14.md)
  : Bayesian analysis for age estimation of OSL measurements and C-14
  ages of various samples

- [`Catalhoyuk`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Catalhoyuk.md)
  : Example Data for Bayesian Age Model

- [`Compute_AgeS_D()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Compute_AgeS_D.md)
  : Bayesian Models for Age Estimation with Priors from ModelAgePrior
  Dataset

- [`Compute_AgeS_DC14()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Compute_AgeS_DC14.md)
  : Bayesian Models for Age Estimation with Priors from Model_DC14
  Dataset

- [`DATA1`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/DATA1.md) :
  DATA of sample named GDB3

- [`DATA2`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/DATA2.md) :
  DATA on sample named GDB5

- [`DATA3`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/DATA3.md) :
  DATA of sample named FER1

- [`DATA_C14`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/DATA_C14.md)
  : C14 cal age estiamte and its error

- [`Generate_DataFile()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Generate_DataFile-deprecated.md)
  : Generates, from one (or several) BIN-file(s) of Single-grain OSL
  measurements, a list of luminescence data and information before
  statistical analysis (DEPRECATED)

- [`Generate_DataFile_MG()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Generate_DataFile_MG-deprecated.md)
  : Generates, from one (or several) BIN file(s) of Multi-grain OSL
  measurements a list of luminescence data and information before
  statistical analysis (DEPRECATED)

- [`IntCal13`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/IntCal13.md)
  : Atmospheric North data for calibration of 14C age

- [`IntCal20`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/IntCal20.md)
  : Atmospheric North data for calibration of 14C age

- [`IsotonicCurve()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/IsotonicCurve.md)
  : Compute Isotonic Regression for different stratigraphic constraints

- [`LT_RegenDose()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/LT_RegenDose-deprecated.md)
  : Plots Lx/Tx as a function of the regenerative dose (DEPRECATED)

- [`MCMCsample`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/MCMCsample.md)
  : MCMC sample from the posterior distribution of the dataset GDB5

- [`Marine13`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Marine13.md)
  : Marine data for calibration of 14C age

- [`Marine20`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Marine20.md)
  : Marine data for calibration of 14C age

- [`ModelAgePrior`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/ModelAgePrior.md)
  :

  JAGS Models for OSL Age Estimation in `Compute_AgeS_D`

- [`ModelC14`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/ModelC14.md)
  :

  Likelihood of C14 samples for JAGS models use in `Age_OSLC14`

- [`ModelOSL`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/ModelOSL.md)
  :

  Likelihood of OSL samples for JAGS models use in `Age_OSLC14`

- [`ModelPrior`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/ModelPrior.md)
  :

  Prior for JAGS models use in `Age_OSLC14`

- [`Model_Age`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Model_Age.md)
  :

  JAGS models use in `Age_Computation`

- [`Model_AgeC14`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Model_AgeC14.md)
  :

  JAGS models use in `AgeC14_Computation`

- [`Model_AgeS`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Model_AgeS.md)
  :

  JAGS models use in `AgeS_Computation`

- [`Model_DC14`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Model_DC14.md)
  :

  JAGS Models for OSL Age Estimation in `Compute_AgeS_DC14`

- [`Model_Palaeodose`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Model_Palaeodose.md)
  :

  JAGS models use in `Palaeodose_Computation`

- [`OSLJingbian`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/OSLJingbian.md)
  : Example Data for OSL Bayesian Age Model

- [`Palaeodose_Computation()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/Palaeodose_Computation.md)
  : Bayesian analysis for the palaeodose estimation of various samples

  Plot graphs build to vizualise isotonic distorsion of the function

  The user needs to note that only one HPD regions / Credible Interval
  level can be allowed and vizualized.

  : Create Stratigraphically Ordered Sample Matrix

  : Atmospheric South data for calibration of 14C age

  : Atmospheric South data for calibration of 14C age

- [`plot_RegDosePoints()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/plot_RegDosePoints.md)

- [`plot_Scatterplots()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/plot_Scatterplots.md)
  [`ScatterSamples()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/plot_Scatterplots.md)

- [`remove_transitive_edges()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/remove_transitive_edges.md)
  :

  The Edge Pruner Algorithm (EPA). This algorithm handles the redundancy
  of the constraints matrix (see
  [`create_ThetaMatrix()`](https://imn167.github.io/BayLumPlus/reference/create_ThetaMatrix.md))
  by deleting all unecessary edges. The result is
